environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4) with no additional filtering. The SQLite database file is on an EBS volume mounted at /var/lib/app/. The application is run via gunicorn with 4 workers. Security groups allow inbound TCP 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or proxy-level inspection is configured. API keys are issued to any registered developer via a self-service portal.

config.api_key_policy: self-service issuance, no request-level authorization beyond authentication
